_meta.purpose: Golden set for the deterministic topic tagger (regwatch_sources/tagging.py). tests/test_topic_precision.py fails if micro precision or recall falls below the thresholds.
_meta.labelled_by: scraper-v2 agent, 2026-11-14, from the title text only, before the tag rules were written
_meta.labelling_rule: A case gets a topic when its title, read alone, is about that topic as defined in docs/data/sources/topic-tags.json; [] means no topic from the taxonomy applies. Ambiguous titles (AMLR Art. 32, 39, 63, 71 and the NBB page 'Sanctions') were left out rather than guessed.
